summary: Iteration 5 verification. All 4 new features tested end-to-end. 17/17 new backend pytest cases pass (themes list/select/lock/403, weekly leaderboard with Monday UTC start + game filter + unknown-game 400, friends add/list/remove + self-add 400 + unknown 404 + online status via /auth/me heartbeat, battle rematch requires-ended-400 / not-a-player-403 / idempotent host-wins keeps roles / guest-wins swaps roles). Frontend UI verified for Skin Shop (4 cards, neon unlocked/active, gameboy/CRT/arcade disabled with lock + XP threshold, applying neon sets html data-theme='neon'), Friends page (add/remove works, online chip renders, Battle CTA links to /battles, self-add returns 400 via toast), Leaderboard scope toggle (all-time vs this-week both fetch and render correct rows with wins-this-week). Friends nav present in Layout (desktop + mobile-nav-friends). BattlePlay rematch button data-testid + auto-navigate on rematch_id confirmed via code review.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1024 lines — consider splitting into routers (auth, games, battles, friends, themes) for maintainability. Still borderline acceptable at this size.
Battle rooms are stored in-memory (_battle_rooms dict). Any backend restart will lose all in-flight battles including rematch chains. Fine for MVP but should be documented.

unlocked_themes_for is recomputed on every public_user call and unioned with stored list; the stored 'unlocked_themes' field appears unused (nothing writes to it). Can drop the merge or drop the field.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (skin shop, friends, leaderboard scope all verified)
